stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: The ship clock took four hours!

stations.title: Weekly report
stations.text: Says nothing, and gets the week wrong.

stations.title: Your search
stations.gap: No error, only a wrong number

stations.title: Dorrit's report
stations.text: The longest repair, right every week.

captions: Dorrit reads the weekly report and knows the ship clock was this week's longest repair.
The report names another repair, with no error, after months of right answers.
You cut the week down until the fault shows, and make wrong values speak up.
Now the ship clock is the longest repair on the report, as it should be.
When something goes wrong now, the program says so, and says where.
